description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter news app, including theme setup, route configuration, biometric authentication gating, and app initialization.

classes.name: NewsApp
classes.description: Main app widget setting up theme, routes, and auth gating.

classes.name: _BiometricGate
classes.description: Widget that blocks app launch until biometric authentication is completed.

classes.name: _BiometricGateState
classes.description: State class managing biometric authentication and lifecycle events for the gate.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: Screen displayed on navigation errors, showing an error message.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Defines and returns the app theme data with color scheme and styles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree with routing and app structure.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles device biometric authentication with fallback to device credentials.

methods.name: _checkAndAuthenticate
methods.description: Performs initial biometric check and prompts user for authentication.

methods.name: _localizedReasonWithFallbackHint
methods.description: Provides user-facing prompt message based on available biometrics.

methods.name: didChangeAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Tracks app lifecycle to determine if re-authentication is needed on resume.
